mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Savings Plan with returns of 6 percent annual interest."
Investment A is a Savings Plan with returns of 6 percent annual interest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a formula which can be thought of as "reversing" conditional probability."
Bayes theorem is a formula which can be thought of as "reversing" conditional probability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a course to be worried about by students in economics and related studies."
Quantitative technique is a course to be worried about by students in economics and related studies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in determining the degree of asymmetry of a distribution; a distribution which is not symmetrical is said to be skewed."
Measures of skewness are used in determining the degree of asymmetry of a distribution; a distribution which is not symmetrical is said to be skewed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical model expressing the relationship between variables."
An Equation is a mathematical model expressing the relationship between variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a name given to numerical data described over a uniform set of time points."
Note that a time series is a name given to numerical data described over a uniform set of time points.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in estimating the average of a given set of observations."
The arithmetic mean is used in estimating the average of a given set of observations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an equation of the second degree."
A Quadratic Equation is an equation of the second degree.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered current assets and loans are considered current liability."
Note that funds received are considered current assets and loans are considered current liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of distinct objects, often referred to as elements or members."
A mathematical set is a collection of distinct objects, often referred to as elements or members.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the modern approach to decision making both in economics and in business."
Decision analysis is the modern approach to decision making both in economics and in business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special case of weighted aggregate index."
A Laspeyres index is a special case of weighted aggregate index.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the total stocks of various kinds including: basic raw materials; partly finished goods and materials; sub- assemblies; office and workshop supplies and finished goods."

A firm's inventory is defined as the total stocks of various kinds including: basic raw materials; partly finished goods and materials; sub- assemblies; office and workshop supplies and finished goods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most useful measure of variation."
The standard deviation is the most useful measure of variation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept that most people understand naturally, since such words as "chance," "likelihood," "possibility" and "proportion are used as part of everyday speech."
Probability is a concept that most people understand naturally, since such words as "chance," "likelihood," "possibility" and "proportion are used as part of everyday speech.

Time-series deflation
Time-series deflation is used to obtain a set of index relatives that measure changes in the real value of some commodities with respect to some given indicators.
______ is a signal that a problem requiring managerial solution exists.
Deviation from an established average
Deviation from an established average is a signal that a problem requiring managerial solution exists.
______ refers to a sequence of numbers, called terms, in which any number after the first can be obtained from the immediate past number by adding a constant number, called the common difference, d.
arithmetic progression

An arithmetic progression refers to a sequence of numbers, called terms, in which any number after the first can be obtained from the immediate past number by adding a constant number, called the common difference, d.
______ is a government bond with 4.5 percent annual interest.
Investment B
Investment B is a government bond with 4.5 percent annual interest.
______ is the converse of simple interest.
Straight line depreciation
Straight line depreciation is the converse of simple interest.
______ are used in developing mathematical models.
Mathematical Tools
Mathematical Tools are used in developing mathematical models.
______ is a measure of central tendency which appears in the "middle" of an ordered sequence of values or observations.
median
The median is a measure of central tendency which appears in the "middle" of an ordered sequence of values or observations.
______ can be defined as the degree of relationship between two or more variables.
Correlation
Correlation can be defined as the degree of relationship between two or more variables.
______ is used for qualitative variables, whereby the variables cannot be measured numerically.
Rank correlation coefficient
Rank correlation coefficient is used for qualitative variables, whereby the variables cannot be measured numerically.
______ is a quick measure of central tendency or average.
mode
The mode is a quick measure of central tendency or average.
______ is a rectangular array of numbers, called entries.
matrix
A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers, called entries.
______ is a set of equations with two or more unknown.
simultaneous equation system
A simultaneous equation system is a set of equations with two or more unknown.
______ can be defined as the ratio of the sum of commodity prices in a given current period to the sum of same commodity prices in the selected base year (or period).
Simple Price Index
The Simple Price Index can be defined as the ratio of the sum of commodity prices in a given current period to the sum of same commodity prices in the selected base year (or period).
______ are used by policy makers to decide on tax changes, subsidies to parastatals, industries, and so on.
Index numbers
Index numbers are used by policy makers to decide on tax changes, subsidies to parastatals, industries, and so on.
______ is a term used to describe anything measurable and has some economic relevance.
Economic commodity
Economic commodity is a term used to describe anything measurable and has some economic relevance.
